name: Denial Of Christ
overview: The denial of Christ is vividly illustrated in Matthew 26:69-74, where Peter, confronted multiple times about his association with Jesus, repeatedly denies knowing Him, even swearing falsely. This act of denial is not only a personal failure but also reflects a broader spiritual reality, as denial in doctrine and practice characterizes false teachers and aligns with the spirit of Antichrist. Scripture warns that such denial leads to destruction and that Christ Himself will deny those guilty of it, underscoring the grave consequences of rejecting Him openly.
